import unittest
from lines import line_count

class LineCountTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_line_boundaries(self):
        for text, expected in [('', 0), ('one', 1), ('first\\nsecond\\n', 2), ('\\n', 1), ('\\n\\n', 2), ('a\\r\\nb\\rc', 3), ('a\\vb\\fc\\x1cd\\x1de\\x1ef\\x85g\\u2028h\\u2029i', 9), ('   ', 1)]:

result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(LineCountTests))
print('Integration observation:', summarize('one two\\nthree\\n'), '; expected:', {'words': 3, 'lines': 2})
